messages.content: I want to wash my car. The car wash is only 50 meters from my house. Should I walk or drive there?

response.text:
Considering the distance is only 50 meters, walking is likely the most convenient and environmentally friendly option. You'll save time, energy, and potentially some money on fuel. Additionally, walking is a great way to get some exercise and fresh air before washing your car.

Unless you have a mobility issue or other concerns, walking 50 meters is a short and manageable distance. So, go ahead and walk to the car wash!
